application_sentences: The chamber is ideal for material testing applications.
They can also be used for room temperature testing without re-configurations.
The chamber is mounted to a weighted floor sled and can be wheeled into position for testing at elevated or low temperatures.
Liquid nitrogen gas is used for cooling the chamber, while electric induction coils are used to heat up the chamber.
A video or laser extensometer can be used for high accuracy strain data.
​ Chilling Machine - Cold/Long - The chiller is used for cooling down to about -50 Celsius for long periods of time.
The chilling system is similar to that used for the Charpy Chiller.
Normal air hoses can melt if they are used for testing over 70°C.
